headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man City, Man Utd, Spurs eye Atlético's Simeone
description: Man City, Man United and Tottenham are all looking at bringing Atlético Madrid's Giuliano Simeone to the Premier League. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Solanke rescues point for 10-man Spurs against United
description: Dominic Solanke pounces in injury time as a 10-man Tottenham outfit snatch a late 1-1 draw against Manchester United.

headline: Gunners come from behind to beat Leeds
description: Arsenal strike twice in eight second-half minutes through Riccardo Calafiori and Bruno Guimarães to claim a 2-1 comeback win over Leeds.

headline: Dawson: Manchester United board may act if results don't improve
description: Dawson: Manchester United board may act if results don't improve

headline: Roberto De Zerbi: I 'kissed' Rodrigo Bentancur after red card, the 'character' that Spurs need
description: Tottenham Hotspur boss Roberto De Zerbi has revealed that he "kissed" Rodrigo Bentancur after his red card against Manchester United on Saturday, saying that his Spurs team need this type of "reaction."

headline: Michael Carrick 'hurt' by boos as Man United fall to worst start in 40 years
description: Michael Carrick said the boos at Old Trafford "hurt" after the 1-1 draw with Tottenham condemned Manchester United to their worst start to a season for 40 years.
